title: Yoke-strap Harness
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, the yoke turned to armour instead of a load.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now strap a keel yoke down with drag cord into a harness, worn rather than carried.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking drag cord, for anyone who would rather buy than pull it off a fork drag.

items.name: Yoke-strap harness
items.examine: A keel yoke worn instead of shouldered, strapped down until it stops sliding.
